purpose.zh: 练肩部和侧腹，提升单臂支撑稳定
purpose.en: Build the shoulders and obliques and steady your single-arm support.

text.zh: 支撑手在肩正下方，推地让肩远离耳朵
text.en: Keep your hand under your shoulder and push the floor away

text.zh: 髋慢慢下沉再抬回，身体侧面成一条直线
text.en: Lower your hips slowly, then lift back to a straight side line.

text.zh: 另一只手放在髋上，肩和脚保持不动
text.en: Rest your other hand on your hip and keep your shoulders and feet still.

commonErrors.en: Letting the shoulder sink toward the ear.
Not lifting the hips back into line.

cautions.zh: 先做手腕热身；手腕刺痛或发麻就停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first, and stop if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
